storage.title: How your data is stored
storage.description: All your data is stored locally in your browser using IndexedDB — a permanent, browser-native database. Your data survives closing the browser, restarting your computer, and software updates. Nothing is sent to any server.
storage.indexedDb: Original data (benchmarks, conversations, comparisons, training) is stored in 6 dedicated IndexedDB databases — one per feature. IndexedDB is NOT session storage — it persists permanently until you choose to delete it.
storage.historyDb: The History database is a unified research index powered by Dexie.js. It records a summary of every experiment for fast querying and trend analysis. Think of it as a search engine over all your LLMxRay activity.
storage.privacy: Everything stays on your machine. Only two things can remove it: you clearing browser site data, or using the Clear buttons in this app. There are no accounts, no cloud sync, no telemetry.

results.noEntries: No history entries yet. Run a benchmark, comparison, or chat to start building your research archive.
